description: ANYstructure is the ANYstructure project's desktop tool for assessing and optimising steel plate fields and cylinders. It contains calculations for scantlings, buckling, fatigue, weight and cost, with a graphical interface and optional finite-element connections. Users supply structural geometry, loads and design choices; the software returns calculated checks and candidate designs. Spatial coverage is the selected structural component, while load cases and fatigue assumptions determine temporal coverage. Python source is free under MPL-2.0 from version 6.4.0; documentation uses CC-BY-4.0 and referenced standards retain their own terms. A limitation is that implemented rule checks do not independently certify a structure. Orthotropic shells are not supported by the documented finite-element workflow, and Excel-based functions require Excel. The tool supports design and retrofit simulations for civil and marine infrastructure. QGIS (platform-qgis) is a related spatial preparation tool, without an established direct interface. No engineering calculation was executed.
